utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, how's the repair drive going? Need any extra hands or tools?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I could use a hand organizing the tools. Have you got a minute to sort through them with me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I've got a few minutes. Let's take a look at what you've got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? When is that again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Next Saturday, 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, next Saturday at 10. Got it, I'll try to swing by if I'm free.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is actually going to fix anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don't know, I hope so, but I'm worried it might not be enough.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: If you're not even sure it'll work, why are we bothering?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Cleo! The repair drive, right? I think I have some old tools in my garage somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great, Oren! I've been making a list of what everyone's bringing, so I'll add your tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, yes, tools. Don't let me forget them though—I might need a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I heard you mention a repair drive. Could you tell me more about what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think we're collecting old electronics to fix up, but I can't remember the exact drop-off spot. Sorry, I'm a bit scatterbrained today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No problem, I can try to help figure it out. Do you remember who's organizing it or where you heard about it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I'm late, what did I miss about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! I was just explaining that we're collecting old electronics to fix up for the community center. Got any spare gadgets?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, that's a great idea! I have an old laptop gathering dust that I could contribute.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Gus, I heard about the repair drive. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Sam! I've got a truck full of tools we can use. Let's head over to Mrs. Henderson's first—she's got a broken fence.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I'll grab my gloves and meet you at the truck.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know where the repair drive is happening today?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think it's at the community center, but let me check the school flyer to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks for double-checking. I'll wait to hear what the flyer says.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, did you hear about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? I'm bringing in my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that's awesome! I've been telling everyone about it. Maybe we can get a bunch of folks to come together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I hope so! It'd be great to see a big turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey, what's this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, it's just a community thing to fix up shared spaces. I heard they're organizing a team for the park benches.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When are you planning to start on the benches?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, I heard there's a repair drive happening this Saturday. Are you going?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive? I hadn't heard about it. What exactly is happening?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's at the community center from 10 to 4. People are bringing in broken appliances and furniture for free fixes. I'm planning to take my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli! I'm glad I ran into you. Are you still available to help with the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, um... I'm sorry, I don't think I can make it this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's a shame! But no worries, thanks for letting me know. Maybe another time?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I think they're fixing up old appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I hadn't heard about that. What's the schedule? I like to keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's on Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM at the community center, and they're even offering free coffee and donuts!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Vik. Did I miss anything important?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No, you didn't miss much. We were just discussing the repair drive for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, good. So, what's the plan? Do we need any specific tools or volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Is the repair drive open to everyone?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, anyone in the neighborhood can come by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to know. What kind of repairs do you usually handle?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's a community event where we pool tools and know-how to fix up broken things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, when is it? I might swing by if I have time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! Are you heading to the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? I haven't heard the details yet. When exactly is it and what's the plan?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center. They'll have tools and experts to help fix small appliances, clothes, and furniture!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Mara! The repair drive? I think I read something about that... or maybe I didn't. What's the deal?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's a neighborhood event to fix up things together—like broken furniture, electronics, or clothes. We're collecting items now and will have a repair workshop next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, right! I think I have an old lamp that needs fixing. I'll try to remember to bring it... if I don't forget again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, I heard you're organizing a repair drive—how's that going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's going well! Got a decent pile of old lawnmowers and toasters waiting for some TLC.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, that sounds like a good start. Need any help sorting through them?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're working on a repair drive. Need any help with that?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, actually. Could use a hand lifting the old engine block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can give you a hand. When are you planning to do it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, the repair drive? That's a big project. Do we have a plan for how to coordinate the volunteers and the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's the current status on supplies? Do we have a list?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure we have a comprehensive list yet. I can start gathering an inventory of what we have and what we'll need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, have you heard? We're organizing a repair drive this weekend to fix up the park benches. Would you like to join us?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds great! I can help by keeping track of the supplies we'll need. Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Cleo! I'll let you know the list of supplies we'll need. Are you free Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Oren, what time is the repair drive? I need to work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, shoot, I can't quite recall—did I already tell you? I think it's maybe around 10?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 might work—what's the exact start? I've got to get the kids by 3.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell! I'm so glad you're interested in the repair drive. We're planning it for next Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, next Saturday morning works for me! What can I bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful! We could really use some help sorting donated items and setting up the repair stations. I'll send you a list of what to bring.
